Create a complete single self-contained file `chip8_openrouter-google-gemini-3.8-flash_01.html` (HTML + CSS + JavaScript inline;
no external libraries, CDNs, assets or backend). Build a working CHIP-8 emulator.

Implement the interpreter properly: 4 KB of memory with the font set loaded at 0x050 and programs at 0x200,
sixteen 8-bit registers V0 to VF, the 16-bit index register, the program counter, a call stack, and the
delay and sound timers counting down at 60 Hz. Decode and execute the complete instruction set of 35
instructions, including the arithmetic and logic group with the carry and borrow flags in VF, the shift
instructions, jumps and calls, the random instruction, BCD conversion, register save and load, and the key
tests.

The display is 64 by 32 pixels drawn on a canvas scaled to a readable size, with sprites drawn by XOR and
the collision flag set in VF. The 16-key keypad is mapped to a 4 by 4 block of keyboard keys shown in the
interface; key press and release must both reach the emulator.

Include a small demo ROM as a byte array inside the file: a real program, assembled by you, that draws a
sprite and moves or reacts to a key, so that the emulator can be tried without any download. Also allow
loading a ROM from a local file.

Add run, pause, single step and reset controls, an adjustable instructions-per-frame speed, and a debugger
panel showing the registers, the index register, the program counter, the stack and the decoded current
instruction. Every visible control must work. Deliver the one file `chip8_openrouter-google-gemini-3.8-flash_01.html`.

  * 00E0 (CLS) - Clear screen
  * 00EE (RET) - Return from subroutine
  * 0NNN (SYS addr) - ignored or treated as NOP
  * 1NNN (JP addr) - Jump to NNN
  * 2NNN (CALL addr) - Call subroutine at NNN
  * 3XNN (SE Vx, byte) - Skip next instruction if Vx == NN
  * 4XNN (SNE Vx, byte) - Skip next instruction if Vx != NN
  * 5XY0 (SE Vx, Vy) - Skip next instruction if Vx == Vy
  * 6XNN (LD Vx, byte) - Set Vx = NN
  * 7XNN (ADD Vx, byte) - Set Vx = (Vx + NN) & 0xFF (no carry flag modified)
  * 8XY0 (LD Vx, Vy) - Vx = Vy
  * 8XY1 (OR Vx, Vy) - Vx = Vx | Vy (resets VF to 0 in classic/modern configurable, default classic/standard)
  * 8XY2 (AND Vx, Vy) - Vx = Vx & Vy
  * 8XY3 (XOR Vx, Vy) - Vx = Vx ^ Vy
  * 8XY4 (ADD Vx, Vy) - Vx = Vx + Vy; VF = carry (1 if sum > 255 else 0); Vx = (Vx + Vy) & 0xFF
  * 8XY5 (SUB Vx, Vy) - Vx = Vx - Vy; VF = NOT borrow (1 if Vx >= Vy else 0); Vx = (Vx - Vy) & 0xFF
  * 8XY6 (SHR Vx {, Vy}) - Support configurable or standard shift: VF = LSB of Vx (or Vy); Vx = Vx >> 1
  * 8XY7 (SUBN Vx, Vy) - Vx = Vy - Vx; VF = NOT borrow (1 if Vy >= Vx else 0); Vx = (Vy - Vx) & 0xFF
  * 8XYE (SHL Vx {, Vy}) - VF = MSB of Vx (Vx >> 7 & 1); Vx = (Vx << 1) & 0xFF
  * 9XY0 (SNE Vx, Vy) - Skip next instruction if Vx != Vy
  * ANNN (LD I, addr) - Set I = NNN
  * BNNN (JP V0, addr) - Jump to NNN + V0
  * CXNN (RND Vx, byte) - Vx = Math.floor(Math.random() * 256) & NN
  * DXYN (DRW Vx, Vy, nibble) - Draw N-byte sprite from memory[I] at (Vx % 64, Vy % 32). XOR mode with wrapping/clipping. If any pixel flipped from 1 to 0, VF = 1, else 0.

  * EXA1 (SKNP Vx) - Skip next instruction if key in Vx is NOT pressed

- 64x32 monochrome buffer
- HTML5 Canvas rendered with crisp pixel art (crisp-edges/pixelated), configurable colors (e.g. Classic Green, Amber, Cyberpunk Neon, White/Black OLED)

  4 5 6 D   -> mapped to QWERTY: Q W E R
  7 8 9 E   -> mapped to QWERTY: A S D F

- Keydown and keyup events tracked properly.

  An interactive game/demo, e.g., an interactive character/sprite that moves around with directional keys (e.g., 2/W = up, 8/S/X = down, 4/A = left, 6/D = right, or 1-4/Q-R), bounces, reacts to collisions, has an obstacle or counter.
- Plus a second demo like a graphic test or logo / animation.
- File upload input (`<input type="file">`) to load any standard .ch8 ROM from disk with drag & drop support.
5. Controls & Features:
- Run / Pause button
- Single Step button
- Reset button
- Adjustable speed: Instructions Per Frame (slider from 1 to 50, default ~10-15) and clock rate display
- Volume / Mute toggle for the buzzer
- Color theme selector
6. Debugger Panel:
- Current PC and Opcode with human-readable disassembly text (e.g., "0x0214: 6010 -> LD V0, 0x10")
- Disassembly window showing previous, current, and next instructions
- Table/grid of all 16 registers V0 - VF in hex and decimal
- Index register I (hex and decimal)
- Program counter (PC)
- Stack pointer and stack contents visualization
- Delay timer and Sound timer displays
- Step-by-step trace and execution logs
7. UI Design:
- Modern, sleek, dark-mode retro-cyber terminal / lab aesthetic
- Grid layout with sidebar for debugger and controls, clean typography, phosphor glow effects on canvas
- 100% self-contained in `chip8_openrouter-google-gemini-3.8-flash_01.html`, no external scripts, no fonts from external CDN, standard system monospace fonts.","path":"chip8_openrouter-google-gemini-3.8-flash_01.html"}
